meta.title: Honey Beauty Salon — Beauty, kissed by honey
meta.description: Premium beauty salon in Chișinău. Manicure, pedicure, lashes, brows, makeup and hair. Book online in seconds.

hero.title: Beauty, kissed by <gold>honey</gold>
hero.subtitle: Refined treatments, expert hands and an atmosphere made for slowing down. At Honey, every detail is for you.

about.title: A salon designed with care, for you
about.p1: At Honey Beauty Salon we believe beauty is a ritual — a moment that's yours alone, when you stop, breathe and feel beautiful. Our team blends classic techniques with modern trends, using premium products and tools sterilised to the highest standards.
about.p2: Whether you drop in for a quick manicure or want a full look for a special occasion, you'll walk out glowing.

highlights.hygieneDesc: Autoclave-sterilised tools for every single client.
highlights.teamDesc: Certified specialists with years of experience.
highlights.comfortDesc: An intimate space designed for total relaxation.

services.title: Everything you need to glow
services.subtitle: From flawless hands to captivating eyes — every service is delivered with passion and precision.

manicure.title: Manicure
manicure.description: Classic, Japanese or premium gel manicure. Perfect shapes, custom design and an impeccable finish.

pedicure.title: Pedicure
pedicure.description: SPA pedicure with full care, exfoliation and long-lasting finish — for perfectly groomed feet.

lashes.title: Lash extensions
lashes.description: Classic, 2D, 3D or mega-volume. Comfortable, natural and long-lasting lashes, applied one by one.

brows.title: Brow design
brows.description: Brow architecture, henna or paint tinting, lamination — your gaze, gently enhanced.

makeup.title: Makeup
makeup.description: Day, evening or event makeup. Modern techniques and long-wear products.

hair.title: Hair styling
hair.description: Cuts, styling, colouring and treatments. Your hair, in the hands of the best stylists.

barber.title: Men's barbering
barber.description: Classic and modern cuts, fades, beard shaping and shaving rituals — men deserve a moment of style too.

gallery.title: Our work
gallery.subtitle: A selection of our work — every detail matters.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.subtitle: We're proud of every kind word. Here's a selection from our Google reviews.

maria.name: Maria T.
maria.text: The best salon in Chișinău! Lovely atmosphere, true professionals and a flawless result. I recommend it to all my friends.

elena.name: Elena V.
elena.text: My lashes look incredibly natural and last for months. I've been a regular for over a year and would not go anywhere else.

ana.name: Ana S.
ana.text: My bridal makeup was exactly what I dreamed of — delicate, long-lasting and flawless all day. Thank you, Honey!

contact.title: Come visit us
